attention4.ptxt: Applying a shock to the catalytic converter may cause damage to the inside the catalyst.
Handle the catalytic converter carefully not to drop it or hit it against something.

s1.ptxt: Release HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 wire harness from clamps (1).
Disconnect HO2S-1 (1) and HO2S-2 (2) connectors and then detach from their bracket.
Remove HO2S-1 and HO2S-2, if necessary.
Remove exhaust pipe bolts (1) from exhaust pipe.
Remove catalytic converter stiffener (2) and catalytic converter stiffener bolt (3).
Remove catalytic converter (1) and its gasket from turbocharger.
Remove catalytic convert stud bolts from turbocharger.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: If the turbocharger is to be reused, check the threaded holes in the flange and the mating surface for rust which may cause loosening of the bolts and nuts.
If rusted, remove the rust by grinding the surface and tapping the threaded holes.
Torx® type stud bolt head could be damaged when tightening.
Carefully tighten the stud bolt.
Use new gasket and seal ring.
Use new catalytic converter bolts, stud bolts and nuts.
Tighten new stud bolt until incomplete thread reaches.
Install catalytic converter and its stiffener as follows.
Install catalytic converter (1), and tighten new catalytic converter nuts (2), by hand.
Fit catalytic converter stiffener (3) to catalytic converter, and tighten catalytic converter stiffener nut (4) and bolts (5) by hand.
Tighten catalytic converter nuts and catalytic converter stiffener nut until they are seated, and then loosen all nuts about 90°.
Tighten catalytic converter stiffener bolts until they are seated, and then loosen both bolts about 90°.
Tighten new catalytic converter bolts (6) and nuts to specified torque.
Tighten catalytic converter stiffener nut to specified torque.
Fully tighten catalytic converter stiffener bolts in numerical order (“1” – “2”) to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe bolts (1) to specified torque.
Install HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 if removed.
Clamp HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 lead wire.
Refill cooling system with coolant.
Check cooling system for leakage.
Run engine and check for exhaust gas leakage.
